notes.title: DevBlog #6
notes.content:
Hello Pioneers! 

This time around, we spent a lot of time working on cool new features that add a lot to the game.
A lot of changes were focused on exploration so the player can explore more easily while not getting lost.

Features:
[list]
[*] The player can now swim and go under water
[*] Ingame release notes
[*] Footstep sound fx change depending on what kind of ground you are stepping on
[*] World markers to track the last bed you slept in and other players
[/list]

BugFixes:
[list]
[*] Item eat interaction isn't always working
[*] Wild onion has no physics and just float in the air
[*] There is an interaction text when looking at uninteractble objects
[*] Item database does not load in build
[*] LODs where not used correctly
[*] Plant growth was not working as intended
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the time scale
[*] Force the time to be static in the main menu
[*] Got rid of some unwanted effects and sounds
[*] Automatically detect the correct player vertical spawn position
[*] Reworked terrain generation so it is more flat
[/list]

[*] New weather system
[*] Experimented with vegetation coloring

[*] Added new sound effects

notes.title: DevBlog #4
notes.content:
Hello Pioneers! Todays post will be short and sweet but we still wanted to keep you all in the loop. For the past two weeks we've been making a lot of invisible progress such as fixing bugs, improving our networking solution and just really catching up on a lot of technical debt.

Here is a list of some of the things we've been working on:
[list]
[*] Improved positioning of player status icons
[*] Made the hotbar scrollable and only selects occupied slots for faster equipping
[*] Players now sync properly in multiplayer
[*] Multiplayer now validates server versions
[*] Implemented a settings menu
[*] Added new sound effects
[*] Began using the new basic character model setup
[/list]

Beyond this we're still working on the new animation system but it is finally approaching feature parity with the old system.

Screenshot of the new modular character, don't mind the lack of clothes for now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/57cefda0e98debef2991b596d2ed8b9610605f52.png[/img]

Once the new system is in we will do an investigation into some technical aspects that we think could increase performance for players as well as simplify our development efforts, but more on that another time :)

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: DevBlog #3
notes.content:
Hello Pioneers! After releasing our second devlog and hearing everyones feedback we've decided to make an attempt to more frequently post updates on Steam for all our fans. Before this we mainly posted updates in our Discord but we recognize that far from all of our followers are present on Discord.

That being said, since the second devlog we've been working on a lot of different stuff.

[h2]New movement mechanics[/h2]
We've reworked the player movement mechanics as they felt sluggish during playtesting.

[h2]Customizable Character[/h2]
We have been working for some time on a character that the player eventually can customize
and that can show the various clothing they have equipped (we're still missing models for the clothes but the mechanics are in at least)

[h2]New Player Animations[/h2]
Together with the new movement mechanics and the customizable character we've also been feeling
that the animations of the character have not been up to par with what we aim for. Thus we have 
been working for quite some time experimenting and adjusting new animations for the player.
This is still not complete but we're excited to implement it. Since we are missing a
dedicated animator in the team it is all taking some extra time.

[h2]New Seasonal colors[/h2]
We've calibrated the colors for all seasons. Before we had this very bright green for vegetation during summer but we found that the colors just didn't play that well in cohesion to the rest of the objects in the game.
Because of this we have recalibrated all colors to what we feel is a much more fitting color scheme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/5e4fdd5f874eeaf2c1d570d72de3791249b1a186.png[/img]

[h2]Snow[/h2]
Together with calibrating the colors of the seasons we have also added snow which accumulates and builds on the ground the more it snows. We're also experimenting with making the snow volumetric (fluffy) but with that we also get some other gameplay challenges (such as finding items and buildings that are snowed over etc)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/780797fed1287f604ae0f0cda9924abc01179e44.png[/img]

[h2]New vegetation and items[/h2]
Every week the world of Far North become more diverse and sprawling! We've added the following collectible items that can be found in the world
[list]
[*] Carrot
[*] Onion
[*] Stick
[*] Chanterelle & other mushrooms
[*] Apple
[*] Thistles
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/598e1758d1f267135424ce5bb6be7d9873d2f51b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/256bacd489470de57f29cbe2dce17a1640e50d2b.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting[/h2]
With the addition of the new collectible items we also added a crafting system.
You can now craft.
[list]
[*] Plank
[*] Cordage
[*] Sharp Rock
[*] Stone Axe
[*] Hand Drill
[*] Torch
[/list]

There are still a lot of missing functionality when it comes to the crafting in the game but we're slowly getting there!

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
With great multiplayer comes.. lots of networking issues! We've been spending a lot of time redoing parts of our networking solution in order to make the game run smoothly when playing with friends. This is of course a constant work in progress, but we're a little ways off still until we complete the overhaul of the multiplayer.

[h2]Storage[/h2]
As simple as that, we've finally added storage that the player can build to off-load their own inventory! Just be careful of your friends, you don't want them stealing your stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/3d31932843b3d65ec4f408114d44c548bfce6138.png[/img]

If you have questions please feel free to join our discord or post in the forums.

Have a great week!

notes.title: DevBlog #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! Welcome to the first development blog for Far North. 

In the effort to be transparent with our growing community, we decided to start making these blog posts on a regular basis to let everyone know what we are working on and how the game is evolving.

Before jumping into the current development, let me introduce the team and what has been done so far.

[h2]The team[/h2]

The team is composed of three passionate game developers:

[h3]Tim[/h3]
[b]Role:[/b] Programmer, Designer

Tim is the one who came up with the game idea. He is mainly working on pretty much everything you could see so far in our sneak peeks: Lighting, Sky, Level Design and some other core systems. It is thanks to him that the game looks gorgeous :)

[h3]Andrew[/h3]
[b]Role:[/b] 2D/3D Artist, Music

Andrew has been working on the theme music for the game and also producing all the images we need for various platforms. Currently he is creating new 3D assets and textures.

[h3]Marc[/h3]
[b]Role:[/b] Programmer

Marc has been working on the core mechanics of the game and also the multiplayer integration.

[h2]Where is the game at right now[/h2]

Since the beginning of the development we have been focusing on two aspects of the game:

[h3]The game play loop[/h3]

The game play loop defines the main actions the player will do in the game.

The main purpose of the game is Survival. Even if we don't want the whole game play experience to solely focus on survival, its still at the hearth of the game and can't be ignored.

We worked on various systems that will be part of this loop:
Health, Inventory, Cooking, Calories, Interaction, Wood chopping, Building, etc...

[h3]The player experience[/h3]

Tim has been working really hard to make this our vision of the game comes true. We have a full day and night cycle based on real data from the far north. A lot of efforts has been put on tweaking all visual aspects of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/5cf8f9ccb2b7ed5b4f4e609519ebb729d3659f53.png[/img]
[h3]Music[/h3]
Andrew and his friends at Sleepy Hollows studio recorded some promising music for the game OST.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/bac9c14b0b1d7ab566c4749694d6e278c565fce8.jpg[/img]

The tracks are still being worked on, be sure to hop in our Discord if you want to hear a sample!

[h2]What are we currently working on[/h2]

[h3]Procedurally generated environment[/h3]

The terrain and vegetation in Far North will be randomly generated to ensure maximum replayability.

[h3]3D environment assets[/h3]

We are modeling some assets that will be used in the game environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/4e4c309f7d50da0260b665c8438fe49fba7fc237.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/74a0bd627b77421bb722096ee848e707e3fb4f3b.png[/img]

[h3]Player Character & Animation[/h3]

Farewell capsule boy ! We finally have an animated character. Note that this will not be the final character but is acting as a place holder so we can start animating stuff!
In the future we hope to have much more character customizations but one step at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206775/9507791503a0f97436d8f685b236e3e88fcc63d1.png[/img]
